```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse) 
```

```{r}
# Read timestamps as character initially
sepa_types <- cols(
  `#Timestamp`   = col_character(),
  Value          = col_double(),
  `Quality Code` = col_double()
)


pitnacree <- list.files(
  path = "~/UoE/1STATS CASE STUDIES/pitnacree",
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
) %>%
  lapply(function(file) read_delim(file, delim = ";", skip = 11,
                                   col_types = sepa_types,
                                   show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  bind_rows()

pitnacree <- pitnacree %>%
  rename(Timestamp = `#Timestamp`) %>%
  mutate(Timestamp = ymd_hms(Timestamp, tz = "UTC"))


timestamp_check <- tibble(
  River = c("Pitnacree"),
  Missing_Timestamps = c(
    sum(is.na(pitnacree$Timestamp))
  )
)

####### Checking if duplicates are identical
print(pitnacree %>%
        filter(duplicated(Timestamp) | duplicated(Timestamp, fromLast = TRUE)) %>%
        arrange(Timestamp))

###### Removing Duplicates
pitnacree <- pitnacree %>% distinct(Timestamp, .keep_all = TRUE)


###### Sort Data chronologically
pitnacree <- pitnacree %>% arrange(Timestamp)
```
